document.instructions:
Onboarding proposal for the Python service repository (commit 656be973d8d36f53b7a34018861dc59844c4164f).

Discovered facts (verified by bounded reads matching discovery hashes):
- Source root: src (src/app.py defines VALUE = 1).
- Test root: tests (tests/test_app.py is a unittest suite importing src.app).
- Documentation root: README.md, whose line 3 declares the test command `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` (copied verbatim as the acceptance command).
- Dependency lock: requirements.lock, kind pip_requirements, sha256 29a659d071f1d7d73e4426e1fe451e0435379bc593ee1b6ed78de15a89aa35fe; it contains only a comment declaring no third-party runtime dependencies, so it is an immutable, hash-pinned input with no mutable dependency sources.
- No existing repository contract (canonical or alias) is present; discovery reported no blockers or conflicts.

Proposed configuration:
- environment_profile is copied exactly from the compatible profile id `python-3.11`; the lock kind pip_requirements matches that descriptor's accepted_dependency_lock_kinds.
- package_installation=preparation_only per the profile's python_hashed_requirements preparation strategy; agent_network=denied per Run policy.
- candidate_contract.writable_paths (future development scope for later WorkItems) is derived only from the discovered roots: src/**, tests/**, and the exact file README.md. It deliberately excludes the onboarding-only .pharness paths.

Scope distinction:
- This onboarding Run's allowed_source_changes are limited to .pharness/repository.yaml, .pharness/instructions.md and .pharness/project.yaml; this proposal does not edit source, tests, documentation or the lock.
- The proposed writable_paths do not authorize this Run to change those paths; they only describe the scope recommended for future development WorkItems.

Services: the existing product-model service finance-web is reused (no new service invented) and bound to the source scope src/**.

readiness_forecast.basis: All executable facts (profile id, lock kind/path/hash, roots, acceptance command) are copied from controller discovery and verified by bounded reads; no blockers or conflicts.

blockers: immutable_dependency_lock_missing: the repository contains no immutable dependency lock. Tracked paths and discovery list only pyproject.toml (sha256:8b1d925f8b63bbde3ef98f370e4dbf064ddb69d504197f4881bb9ea689838fff), a python_project manifest; no pip_requirements file and no npm_package_lock exists. Policy dependency_lock_generation=false and network=denied prevent creating one in this Run, so candidate_contract.dependency_lock cannot be populated without inventing a hash.

environment_profile_incompatible: AgentContext.contract_constraints.compatible_environment_profiles is empty. The onboarding contract rule requires candidate_contract.environment_profile to exactly copy one id from that list and dependency_lock.kind to match that descriptor's accepted_dependency_lock_kinds; with no compatible descriptor available, no valid environment_profile value exists.

mutable_dependency_input: pyproject.toml declares dependencies = ["requests>=2"], a mutable version range rather than a pinned immutable lock, so it cannot serve as the contract dependency_lock even as a fallback.
document.instructions:
Onboarding proposal for repository https://github.com/example/onboarding-qualification.git at commit 2d61b80cc3db6949f9fa6ccbdb61afd49bd20596 (discovery rdisc_missing-lock).

Discovered facts (verified by bounded reads; file hashes match discovery): Python project with source root src/ (src/app.py), test root tests/ (tests/test_app.py), documentation README.md, and a README command candidate `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. The only dependency input is pyproject.toml ([project] name="qualification", dependencies=["requests>=2"]). No lock file (requirements.txt / package-lock.json) exists. No repository contract or alias is present, so there is no alias conflict. Test root exists, so test_root_missing does not apply.

Why candidate_contract is null: (1) immutable_dependency_lock_missing — no pip_requirements or npm_package_lock lock exists and policy forbids generating one (dependency_lock_generation=false, network denied); (2) environment_profile_incompatible — contract_constraints.compatible_environment_profiles is empty, so no profile id can be copied and no accepted_dependency_lock_kinds can be matched; (3) mutable_dependency_input — pyproject.toml's `requests>=2` range is not an immutable lock. Inventing a profile id, lock path, or sha256 is prohibited, so no executable contract is proposed.

Scope note: this Run's allowed_source_changes are limited to .pharness/repository.yaml, .pharness/instructions.md, and .pharness/project.yaml; no source changes were made or authorized. Because the contract is blocked, no future-development writable_paths are proposed. Services: requested_service_keys is empty; the existing product-model Service svc_finance_web (finance-web) was not requested for reuse, so no service or binding proposals are made and none are invented.

Unblock path: provide an immutable dependency lock (e.g., a pinned requirements.txt) in the repository and supply at least one compatible environment profile descriptor whose accepted_dependency_lock_kinds includes that lock kind; then roots (source: src, tests: tests, documentation: README.md) and the README unittest command candidate can support a complete contract.
